study_system.scientific_role: fresh independent candidate for EOG-WF annual metapopulation forecast validation

source.transport_rule: Zenodo is used only as a stable byte transport route for the same public study bundle; no alternative data content may be substituted after response access

public_documentation_basis.long_term_design: annual habitat-patch surveys of the Aland Glanville fritillary metapopulation; the study bundle reports 19 years of habitat surveys
public_documentation_basis.process_match: annual local extinction and recolonization in a discrete habitat-patch network is the intended biological process, unlike systems dominated by unrepresented external recruitment
public_documentation_basis.external_comparator_class: established metapopulation occupancy/colonization/extinction models using patch area/quality/connectivity
public_documentation_basis.detection_boundary: annual patch occupancy is survey-based and imperfect detection must remain explicit; non-detection is not silently treated as perfect biological absence

rationale: the scientific system is a spatially explicit habitat-patch metapopulation in which local extinction and recolonization are core state transitions
the regional patch network is the actual object of long-term census and metapopulation modelling
the intended EOG claim will be conditional on the declared regional patch universe and will not assert complete closure to all immigration outside Aland

allowed_before_gate1: schema/header information that can be obtained without reading occupancy values
coordinate/patch-attribute data only after exact non-response columns are identified
forbidden_before_structural_gate: population abundance values used as biological response

pass_if: README/schema identifies a stable patch ID and spatial coordinates or another deterministic spatial mapping
survey years can be identified without opening outcome values
response and non-response columns/files can be separated deterministically
process/source closure remains scientifically defensible for a regional metapopulation forecast
stop_if: patch spatial mapping is unavailable or ambiguous
outcome values must be inspected to discover basic node/world inputs
the study is not interpretable as a regional patch-transition process under an explicit source policy

post_gate0_sequence: freeze externally calibrated process-scale evidence when defensible
construct response-blind structural scale ladder as analyst-choice coverage bracket
run prospectively declared structural adequacy gate
freeze temporal holdout, source rule, horizon, same-world compression and external metapopulation comparator
only then open occupancy response once
no_rescue_rule: If the fresh candidate fails any pre-response gate, stop without opening biological outcomes and do not alter the gate to force eligibility.
